IF(
  CONTAINS(Sales_Rep_Legal_Entity__c, "ALM"),
  FALSE,
  (
    (
      Sales_Rep_Team__c = "Docket Navigator" &&
      TEXT(SBQQ__BillingFrequency__c) <> "Annual"
    )
    ||
    (
      Sales_Rep_Team__c = "Docket Navigator" &&
      TEXT(SBQQ__PaymentTerms__c) <> "Due Upon Receipt of Invoice" &&
      TEXT(SBQQ__PaymentTerms__c) <> "Due on receipt" &&
      TEXT(SBQQ__PaymentTerms__c) <> "Net 30"
    )
    ||
    (
      Sales_Rep_Team__c = "Docket Navigator" &&
      TEXT(Payment_Type__c) = "Invoice" &&
      SBQQ__NetAmount__c < 1000 &&
      TEXT(CurrencyIsoCode) = "GBP"
    )
    ||
    (
      Sales_Rep_Team__c <> "Docket Navigator" &&
      TEXT(SBQQ__BillingFrequency__c) <> "Annual" &&

    )
    ||
    (
      Sales_Rep_Team__c <> "Docket Navigator" &&
      TEXT(SBQQ__PaymentTerms__c) <> "Due Upon Receipt of Invoice" &&
      TEXT(SBQQ__PaymentTerms__c) <> "Due on receipt" &&
      Sales_Rep_Team__c <> "MBL Seminars"
    )
    ||
    (
      Sales_Rep_Team__c <> "Docket Navigator" &&
      TEXT(Payment_Type__c) = "Invoice" &&
      SBQQ__NetAmount__c < 1000 &&
      TEXT(CurrencyIsoCode) = "GBP" &&
      Sales_Rep_Team__c <> "MBL Seminars"
    )
    ||
    (
      Sales_Rep_Team__c = "Docket Navigator" &&
      TEXT(Payment_Type__c) = "Invoice" &&
      SBQQ__NetAmount__c < 1200 &&
      TEXT(CurrencyIsoCode) = "EUR"
    )
    ||
    (
      Sales_Rep_Team__c <> "Docket Navigator" &&
      TEXT(Payment_Type__c) = "Invoice" &&
      SBQQ__NetAmount__c < 1200 &&
      TEXT(CurrencyIsoCode) = "EUR" &&
      Sales_Rep_Team__c <> "MBL Seminars"
    )
    ||
    (
      Sales_Rep_Team__c = "Docket Navigator" &&
      TEXT(Payment_Type__c) = "Invoice" &&
      SBQQ__NetAmount__c < 1350 &&
      TEXT(CurrencyIsoCode) = "USD"
    )
    ||
    (
      Sales_Rep_Team__c <> "Docket Navigator" &&
      TEXT(Payment_Type__c) = "Invoice" &&
      SBQQ__NetAmount__c < 1350 &&
      TEXT(CurrencyIsoCode) = "USD" &&
      Sales_Rep_Team__c <> "MBL Seminars"
    )
    ||
    (TEXT(Special_Instructions_Identified__c) = "Yes")
  )
